deed_type.description: Type of deed as titled, e.g. Grant Deed, Quitclaim Deed, Warranty Deed.

name.description: Grantor's name as written in the granting clause, without the entity description.

entity_description.description: How the grantor is described, e.g. a municipal corporation, a married couple as joint tenants.

name.description: Grantee's name as written in the granting clause, without the entity description.

entity_description.description: How the grantee is described, e.g. a California Corporation.

consideration_amount.description: Purchase price or consideration stated in the granting clause, as a number.

documentary_transfer_tax.description: Each documentary transfer tax line declared on the deed.

jurisdiction.description: Taxing jurisdiction, e.g. L.A. County or L.A. City.

transfer_tax_basis.description: Basis on which the transfer tax was computed, e.g. full value of the property, or full value less liens.

property_address.description: Street address the property is commonly known as, including city, state and ZIP.

county.description: County in which the property lies.

legal_description.description: The legal description of the property, usually in an exhibit.

map_reference.description: Recorded map reference, e.g. book and pages of Maps.

full_text.description: The full legal description paragraph(s), verbatim.

reservations.description: Rights the grantor excepts and reserves, e.g. mineral rights, each as one sentence.

conditions.description: Each SUBJECT TO condition or notice the conveyance is made subject to, summarized in one sentence each.

name.description: Organization or person to mail the recorded deed to.

recording_info.description: Recorder's stamp, if the deed has been recorded.

document_number.description: Recorder's document or instrument number, or null if not recorded.

recording_date.description: Recording date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if not recorded.

authorizing_ordinance.description: Ordinance or resolution number under which the deed is made, if any.

council_file_number.description: Council file or agenda reference number, if any.

execution_date.description: Date the deed was executed by the grantor, as YYYY-MM-DD.

signatories.description: People who signed or attested the deed on the grantor's behalf.

title.description: Title or capacity, e.g. Mayor, City Clerk.

acknowledgment_date.description: Date of the acknowledgment as YYYY-MM-DD.

commission_number.description: Notary commission number from the seal.
